caption:
"O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allah purifies whom He wills, and Allah is Hearing and Knowing."

Qur'an 24:21 (Surah An-Noor). Part 10 of 52 in our series on everything the Quran and the Prophet's hadith say about zina. Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #Chastity #IslamicReminder #Deen #Guidance

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 24:21, Surah An-Noor. Part of the zina series; passage chosen from api.alquran.cloud keyword searches (en.sahih: unlawful sexual intercourse, adultery, immorality, chaste, private parts, prostitution) and cross-checked by name.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani via api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/<ref>/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih,th.thai,es.cortes, one call per ayah (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-17); each ayah fetched twice and diffed identical; slide text written programmatically from the raw API fields (multi-ayah passages joined with a single space), no retyping.
sourcing.other_editions: en.sahih (Saheeh International), zh.jian (Ma Jian), ms.basmeih (Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih), th.thai (King Fahad Quran Complex), es.cortes (Julio Cortes): same call. ko.korean and ja.japanese: translator listed as unknown by source; slide says 'Translator not specified by source'.
sourcing.source_artifact_note: Artifact scan flagged: th.thai (double space / space before punctuation / whitespace / control char); source text reproduced as-is, not edited.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked against 142 string terms in compliance-policy.json halal section across all edition text: hits = []. The text is scripture addressing the prohibition and legal treatment of zina; it is not promotional or explicit content.
